## The question

What policy issue are you raising? (e.g., "What counts as AI-generated?",
"How should we handle bulk submissions?", "Should we allow retracted
preprints to remain visible?")

## Current state

What GenRxiv does today, if anything.

## Your proposal

What you think GenRxiv should do, and why.

## Trade-offs

What's gained, what's lost, and who is affected.

## Related discussions

Links to any prior issues, discussions, or external references.
